tools.name: orderbook_imbalance
tools.description: Aggregates spot order book depth and returns bid/ask notional within 10/25/50/100 bps of mid, signed imbalance in [-1,1], largest liquidity walls and a directional signal. Paid: 0.02 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: token_audit
tools.description: Inspects mint and freeze authority, token-2022 extensions, proxy and ownership state, privileged functions and top holder concentration. Returns a 0-100 risk score with itemised flags. Paid: 0.20 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: swap_quote_and_build
tools.description: Same-chain Solana swaps route through Jupiter with a referral fee account. Cross-chain and EVM swaps route through LI.FI with an integrator fee. The response contains a serialized unsigned transaction to be signed and broadcast by the caller.
